title: Pineapple Incident
statementMd:
Ted has a pineapple. This pineapple is able to bark like a bulldog! At time $*t*$ (in seconds) it barks for the first time. Then every $*s*$ seconds after it, it barks twice with $1$ second interval. Thus it barks at times $*t*$, $*t* + *s*$, $*t* + *s* + 1$, $*t* + 2*s*$, $*t* + 2*s* + 1$, etc.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ceeaa825ec595432e188568b5854a5b8a6398eb.png)

Barney woke up in the morning and wants to eat the pineapple, but he can't eat it when it's barking. Barney plans to eat it at time $*x*$ (in seconds), so he asked you to tell him if it's gonna bark at that time.

## Input

The first and only line of input contains three integers $*t*$, $*s*$ and $*x*$ ($0 ≤ *t*, *x* ≤ 10^{9}$, $2 ≤ *s* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the time the pineapple barks for the first time, the pineapple barking interval, and the time Barney wants to eat the pineapple respectively.

## Output

Print a single "YES" (without quotes) if the pineapple will bark at time $*x*$ or a single "NO" (without quotes) otherwise in the only line of output.

## Note

In the first and the second sample cases pineapple will bark at moments $3$, $13$, $14$, ..., so it won't bark at the moment $4$ and will bark at the moment $3$.

In the third and fourth sample cases pineapple will bark at moments $3$, $11$, $12$, $19$, $20$, $27$, $28$, $35$, $36$, $43$, $44$, $51$, $52$, $59$, ..., so it will bark at both moments $51$ and $52$.
statementZhMd:
Ted 有一个菠萝。这个菠萝能够像斗牛犬一样吠叫！在时刻 $*t*$（单位：秒），它第一次吠叫。此后每隔 $*s*$ 秒，它会以 $1$ 秒的间隔连续吠叫两次。因此，它会在时刻 $*t*$、$*t* + *s*$、$*t* + *s* + 1$、$*t* + 2*s*$、$*t* + 2*s* + 1$ 等时刻吠叫。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ceeaa825ec595432e188568b5854a5b8a6398eb.png)

Barney 早上醒来后想吃掉这个菠萝，但菠萝吠叫时他不能吃。他计划在时刻 $*x*$（单位：秒）吃掉菠萝，因此请你判断菠萝在该时刻是否会吠叫。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行也是唯一一行包含三个整数 $*t*$、$*s*$ 和 $*x*$（$0 ≤ *t*, *x* ≤ 10^{9}$，$2 ≤ *s* ≤ 10^{9}$）——菠萝第一次吠叫的时刻、菠萝的吠叫间隔，以及 Barney 想要吃掉菠萝的时刻。

## 输出格式

如果菠萝会在时刻 $*x*$ 吠叫，则在输出的唯一一行中输出一个不带引号的 "YES"；否则输出一个不带引号的 "NO"。

## 说明

在第一组和第二组样例中，菠萝会在时刻 $3$、$13$、$14$、……吠叫，因此它不会在时刻 $4$ 吠叫，而会在时刻 $3$ 吠叫。

在第三组和第四组样例中，菠萝会在时刻 $3$、$11$、$12$、$19$、$20$、$27$、$28$、$35$、$36$、$43$、$44$、$51$、$52$、$59$、……吠叫，因此它会在时刻 $51$ 和 $52$ 吠叫。
